b3.bar: B3 — a clocked draft and a stepped draft are the same draft; latency reported
b3.note: ★ The pre-registered worry does not survive the measurement: 14.M expected `value_hawk`'s Phase-9 greedy to be too slow for a 5s clock, and the slowest single pick in a full draft is ~10 ms. The floor stays as a floor — it is what stops the NEXT slow seat overrunning silently — and the app reports actual tick cost so the constant cannot go stale unnoticed.

b4.note: The slot grid is checked against `starter_value`, which reaches the same fill order through a DIFFERENT solver (vectorized `lineup_points_matrix` vs the labelled `inseason.lineup` fill). Both consume RosterSlots.flex_groups, which is 17.1's single fill-order rule.
